lines.en: I pace a few steps in the yard.
My third eye scans around.
I walk slowly to the stone steps.
My steps are neither light nor heavy.
I circle along the corridor.
My robe sweeps the dusty floor.
I step around the pillar.
I stop before the offering table.
I look down at the bricks.
I walk to the door and back.
Back straight, I walk upright.
I am walking while I wait.
I adjust my belt as I go.
My steps tap on the boards.
I stand with folded arms.
My third eye is half shut.
I am regulating my breath.
My robe hangs perfectly still.
I stare at the far hills.
I slowly unclench my fist.
The wind moves my hair.
I rub between my brows.
I say nothing, only stand.
I sink my ki to my core.
I glance up at the light.
I am thinking of long ago.
All three of my eyes are on you.
My shadow on the ground is steady.
I raise my eyes and size you up.
All three eyes are on you.
Have you business here?
I nod to acknowledge you.
Your energy is unfamiliar.
I stand and wait for your first word.
I turn my face toward you.
You stand like a fighter.
Say what you mean.
I gesture for you to sit.

lines.zh: 有话直说，三只眼都在听。
lines.en: Speak plainly; all three eyes are listening.

lines.zh: 你身上的尘土说明你走了远路
lines.en: Your dust says you came far.
I look at your hands.
Relax. I will not strike.
Ask what you came to ask.
I watch you with folded arms.
I grunt low in my throat.

lines.zh: 我三只眼都看着这一拳。
lines.en: All three of my eyes watch that punch.
I step back and hold.
Blood runs from my lip.
I press my side.
A tear opens in my robe.
I catch my breath.
I wipe it away.
I can still stand.
I settle my ki again.
I have no need of these.
I wave it away politely.
Give the food to those in need.
I appreciate the thought.
I take it and look it over.
A student of the arts does not fuss.
I push it back with two fingers.
Better keep it for yourself.
The corner of my mouth moves.
The thought weighs more than the gift.

lines.zh: 你撞上来我连晃都没晃
lines.en: You bump me; I do not even sway.
I step half aside.
Steady yourself before walking.

lines.zh: 我用肩膀轻轻挡了一下
lines.en: I block lightly with my shoulder.
Look where you walk.
All three eyes are on you.
The brick firms under my foot.
That offence is nothing.
We pass each other.
I shift one step aside.
She comes to stand behind me.
Neither of us speaks.
I straighten her cuff.
She taps my shoulder.
We look out the door together.

lines.zh: 她的呼吸和我一个节奏
lines.en: Her breathing matches mine.
I yield my place to her.
The two of us stand close.
Her third eye watches too.
We trade one glance.
I stoop for a dropped book.
I set it back where it belongs.
I pick up half a brick.
I set it back on the steps.
I pick up a student's dropped staff.
I hand it back.
I gather the fallen ash.
I set up the fallen tablet.
I pick up a copper coin.
I tuck it into my sleeve.
I lift my eyes.
There is movement outside.
I lower my arms.
My third eye narrows.
I step toward the doorway.
This visitor means trouble.
I take up a stance.
First I shield those behind me.
I raise my ki.
I hold my gaze on that direction.
I slowly adjust my feet.
I watch his hands.
He goes left; I turn with him.
I will not strike first.
I am measuring his reach.
His shoulder moved first.
I shift weight to my front foot.
He backs off; I do not chase.

lines.zh: 我在等他自己露出空隙
lines.en: I wait for him to open up.
My breath has settled.
I push out a palm strike.
My knife hand cuts at his wrist.
I slip aside and counter.
My knee drives into his flank.
I shove him back three paces.

lines.zh: 手刀切在你腕上，没下狠手。
lines.en: My knife hand finds your wrist; I did not press it.
My elbow closes his path.
He barely blocks it.
I withdraw and step back.
I do not mean to kill him.
I come out through the door.
I take my place in the corridor.
My third eye opens first.

lines.zh: 我从供桌后走出来，脚步很轻。
lines.en: I step out from behind the altar, softly.
This place needs a keeper.
I glance at the rafters.
I walk to the middle of the yard.
The earth underfoot is dry.
I push the door curtain aside.
I am here for whoever comes.
Fire catches my robe's hem.
I come down from a height.
Water enters my nose and mouth.
The blast pushes me back.
The arrow in my shoulder — I pull it out myself.
Magic presses heavy on my chest.
Hunger keeps my ki from rising.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身旁的柱子上
lines.en: Lightning strikes the pillar beside me.
The courtyard tiles vanish from under my feet.
